title: Loop: free Streaks alternative
caption:
Streaks charges $5.99 on iPhone to track your habits. Loop does it on Android for free 🔥

✅ Tick off habits daily and watch your streaks build
✅ Charts for your habit score, history and best streaks
✅ Reminders and home screen widgets
✅ No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases

📱 Android
ℹ️ Loop is Android only, while Streaks is an iPhone app, so this is the closest free swap for Android users. Streaks is a one-time $5.99 purchase, not a subscription

Comment "HABIT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
